key_insight: Colombo is a self-organizing AI research system that studies oracle-based optimization by jointly advancing achievable algorithmic guarantees and lower bounds on unavoidable costs.
engineering_relevance: Its complexity results can help engineers assess whether optimization methods efficiently use a prescribed information interface and where further improvements remain possible.
method: Map known guarantees, lower bounds, and unresolved gaps in a living Complexity Atlas.
Adapt research plans and reciprocally challenge algorithms with hard problem families.
Check claims through independent review and Lean-based formal certification, retaining findings in long-term memory.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal or near-optimal rates for more than fifty Atlas settings, but provides no detailed evaluation or certification coverage.
watch_item: Assess the assumptions and formal-certification coverage of individual results before applying them to practical optimization problems.
paper_title: Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
